summary.discovery_method: PyPI latest-version check plus GitHub PR search/review via gh search issues and gh api/graphql-oriented triage of closed Fixed-# PRs

cases.title: timesince leap-year calculation is wrong around February
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #20868 -- Fixed leap year bug in timesince.' with a developer-accepted fix description tied to the Trac ticket.
cases.local_detail: timesince(date(2024, 2, 29), date(2025, 3, 1)) returned '1 year', missing the extra day implied by the leap-year boundary.
cases.input_summary: Compare dates that cross a leap-day boundary when timesince computes month/day pivots.

cases.title: test client follow=True with query_params crashes on redirect handling
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #36966 -- Fixed ValueError when query_params and follow are used on test client.'
cases.local_detail: Client().get('/redirect/', follow=True, query_params={'a': '1'}) raised AttributeError: 'HttpResponse' object has no attribute 'url'.
cases.input_summary: Use the Django test client on a redirecting view with both follow=True and query_params supplied.
cases.hypothesis_sketch: Generate a redirecting endpoint plus a small query dict and assert the client follows successfully.

cases.title: parse_header_parameters raises LookupError on malformed RFC 2231 codec names
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #36991 -- Handled LookupError in parse_header_parameters().' with an explicit reproducer in the PR body.
cases.local_detail: parse_header_parameters("text/plain; charset*=BOGUS''foo-%c3%a4.html") raised LookupError: unknown encoding: BOGUS.
cases.input_summary: Pass a malformed RFC 2231 parameter whose encoded charset name is invalid.
cases.hypothesis_sketch: st.text(min_size=1).map(lambda bogus: f"text/plain; charset*={bogus}''foo-%c3%a4.html") with bogus restricted to non-codec names

cases.title: QuerySet.acreate calls save instead of asave
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #36888 -- Made QuerySet.acreate() call asave().' and the PR description states the exact dispatch bug.
cases.local_detail: On a model overriding both save() and asave(), acreate() set save_called=True and asave_called=False.
cases.input_summary: Define a model with custom save/asave hooks and create it through QuerySet.acreate().
cases.hypothesis_sketch: Use a dynamically-defined model whose overridden save/asave toggle class-level flags, then await objects.acreate(...)

cases.title: firstof tag accepts missing argument before as instead of raising TemplateSyntaxError
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #36998 -- Raise TemplateSyntaxError when firstof has no argument before as.'
cases.local_detail: Template('{% firstof as x %}') compiled and rendered an empty string instead of raising TemplateSyntaxError.
cases.input_summary: Parse a firstof template tag where 'as' appears without any preceding argument.

cases.title: firstof tag accepts missing argument after as instead of raising TemplateSyntaxError
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #36998 -- Raised TemplateSyntaxError when firstof has no argument after as.'
cases.local_detail: Template('{% firstof foo as %}') compiled and rendered 'a' instead of raising TemplateSyntaxError.
cases.input_summary: Parse a firstof template tag where 'as' appears without the destination variable name.

cases.title: updating an MTI parent field with a child-table F expression raises the wrong FieldError
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed #33091 -- Raised proper FieldError when updating MTI parent field...' and the PR body includes the regression example.
cases.local_detail: RemoteEmployee.objects.update(salary=F('adjusted_salary') / 5) raised FieldError: Cannot resolve keyword 'adjusted_salary' into field. Choices are: id, salary.
cases.input_summary: Use multi-table inheritance and update a parent-table field using an F expression that references a child-table field.
cases.hypothesis_sketch: Generate a parent/child MTI pair with one parent numeric field and one child numeric field, then call update(parent_field=F(child_field))

cases.title: URLField domain inference should skip non-hierarchical schemes
cases.confirmation_signal: Closed fix PR titled 'Fixed URLField to skip domain inference for non-hierarchical schemes'.
cases.local_detail: forms.URLField().to_python('mailto:user@example.com') and .to_python('tel:+15551234567') both returned unchanged strings on local 6.0.3.
cases.input_summary: Call URLField.to_python() with non-hierarchical schemes such as mailto: or tel:.
